subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only `routing.list` Gateway RPC and Agents > Channels binding card for per-agent Discord channel bindings, or keep binding visibility in existing config/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The request improves visibility for an existing binding model, but it adds core Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than repairing a defined bug.

options.title: Accept generic routing visibility
options.body: Review and refresh the linked implementation or a replacement so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and renders selected-agent bindings with focused API/UI tests.

options.title: Keep visibility in config and CLI
options.body: Close this direction after deciding that raw config, docs, and CLI inspection remain the supported binding visibility surfaces.

options.title: Defer API shape
options.body: Keep this issue open as a design item until maintainers settle the routing summary contract and whether it should be Discord-specific or generic.

recommendation.title: Accept generic routing visibility
recommendation.body: Review and refresh the linked implementation or a replacement so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and renders selected-agent bindings with focused API/UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects the Agents Control UI shape and product/API boundary, where the current history and adjacent triage point most strongly to steipete.
